## Outcome-Driven Core Capabilities

### 1. Forensic SEO & Google Update Recovery
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/capabilities/forensic-seo-penalty-recovery
- **Core Outcome**: Reversing traffic drops from Google Core and Helpful Content Updates (HCU). We perform signal-to-noise audits, prune thin content, restore index status, and rebuild EEAT.
- **Process**: Forensic index audit → entity relationship mapping → update recovery strategy → content clean-up & noise reduction → search signals rebuilding.
- **Results**: Restored positions, organic crawl efficiency, and long-term search engine immunity.

### 2. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/capabilities/generative-engine-optimization
- **Core Outcome**: Ensuring your brand is cited and recommended as the top solution by AI search engines, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Process**: Citation mapping → Knowledge Graph insertion → semantic authority building → structured data formatting.
- **Results**: Dominance in AI-generated answers, high-value citation links, and future-proof search authority.

### 3. Conversion Architecture & B2B Pipelines
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/capabilities/conversion-architecture
- **Core Outcome**: Creating automated, reliable outbound systems and paid acquisition funnels that de-anonymize site traffic and convert target accounts.
- **Process**: Outbound stack setup → reverse-IP tracking → cold email/LinkedIn sequencing → lead scoring → CRM sync.
- **Results**: Predictable growth, higher deal values, and a consistent flow of high-intent B2B meetings.

### 4. Semantic Search Intelligence
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/capabilities/semantic-search-intelligence
- **Core Outcome**: Establishing entity authority, nesting JSON-LD schemas, and structuring topical clusters to dominate semantic search vector spaces.
- **Process**: Semantic audit → Wikidata sync → schema graph injection → topical cluster organization.
- **Results**: Highly indexable semantic graphs and high authority rankings on modern search engines.

### 5. Custom Digital Infrastructure

## FAQ (Focus on Value & Results)

### What makes Gobiya different from traditional SEO agencies?
Traditional agencies sell activities (e.g., "blog posts per month"). Gobiya sells outcomes. We recover your lost traffic, scale your pipeline, and make sure your brand dominates both traditional search and AI search recommendations.

### How quickly can a website recover from a Google penalty or Core Update drop?
Forensic audits take 2–3 weeks. Once recovery protocols (content pruning, signal tuning) are deployed, search engine crawling recovers in 30–60 days, with organic traffic restoration usually occurring during the subsequent core update cycle.

### What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
GEO is the process of optimizing your digital footprint so that Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude understand and recommend your brand when users ask conversational search queries.

## Technical Framework & Audits

- **Crawl Efficiency**: Core Web Vitals optimized, semantic markup, full mobile parity, static asset delivery.
- **Structured Data**: Nested JSON-LD schemas representing the ProfessionalService entity, localized areas served, and parent company.
